title: Individual Beef Wellington
method: Preheat the oven to 220°C / gas mark 7.
Halve the puff pastry on a floured surface and roll each into a thin 20cm x 15cm rectangle, brushing both with beaten egg.
Pat steaks dry with kitchen paper, season with salt and pepper, and center one on each pastry sheet.
Spread mushroom pâté across the top of the steaks, fold pastry securely around the meat, crimp the edges, and trim away excess dough.
Transfer parcels to a lightly greased baking sheet, brush tops thoroughly with beaten egg, and bake at the top of the oven for 20–25 minutes until puffed and golden.
